## Checklist

- [ ] `action.yml` still declares every input I added/changed, with a description and sensible default.
- [ ] README inputs/outputs table is updated to match `action.yml`.
- [ ] The embedded shell is POSIX-ish bash and passes `shellcheck` (CI runs actionlint + shellcheck).
- [ ] The smoke-test job passes (or I explained why it can't).
- [ ] No secrets, tokens, or endpoints are hard-coded.
- [ ] If this is a breaking change, I noted the required major version bump below.
